name: throughput
title: Throughput — ping-pong storms
summary: Ping-pong storms with no host round trips: raw event delivery in a null-datamodel system next to ECMAScript pingers answered via _event.origin.
description: Every root invokes children that ping-pong with it forever (null datamodel, static #_parent/#_child routing). A second system runs ECMAScript pingers that address pongers by session URI and are answered via _event.origin. Measures raw event delivery with no host round trips.

more-storms.title: Add 32 storms
more-storms.description: Spawn 32 more ping-pong roots (16 children each)

calm.title: Stop half the storms
calm.description: Terminate half of the storm roots (their children are cancelled)
